sentences.en: Unpredictable things happen to us all the time.
sentences.zh: 我们总是会遇到各种不可预料的事情。

sentences.en: Those little moments shift the direction of your day or your week.
sentences.zh: 这些小插曲改变了你这一天或这一周的走向。

sentences.en: And then there are the bigger things in life.
sentences.zh: 生活中还有一些更大的变故。

sentences.en: The earthquake kind of change that shakes everything around you,
sentences.zh: 那种地震般的改变，撼动了你周围的一切，

sentences.en: that breaks down your sense of who you are and what your life is.
sentences.zh: 打破了你对自己是谁以及生活是什么的认知。

sentences.en: And in the process of getting back on your feet,
sentences.zh: 而在重新站起来的过程中，

sentences.en: you might realize that something's different.
sentences.zh: 你可能会意识到有些东西变了。

sentences.en: Maybe you come out of it with a new perspective,
sentences.zh: 也许你从中获得了一种新的视角，

sentences.en: a sense of direction you never imagined.
sentences.zh: 一种你从未想象过的方向感。

sentences.en: Today on the show, we have two stories of that kind of change
sentences.zh: 今天的节目里，我们将讲述两个关于这种改变的故事，

sentences.en: Oh, and we have some pretty beautiful music that comes with those stories.
sentences.zh: 哦，对了，这些故事还伴随着一些非常美妙的音乐。

sentences.en: Derek Amado is sitting at the piano in NPR Studio One.
sentences.zh: 德里克·阿马多正坐在NPR一号演播室的钢琴前。

sentences.en: As you're listening to him play,
you might think he's had years of musical training.
sentences.zh: 你可能会觉得他受过多年的音乐训练。
但德里克的情况很特殊。

sentences.en: He's said to have something called acquired savant syndrome
sentences.zh: 据说他患有一种叫做“后天学者综合征”的病症，

sentences.en: that left him with the incredible ability to play the piano.
sentences.zh: 这让他拥有了不可思议的钢琴演奏能力。

sentences.en: We'll talk about what that means, but let's back up a minute.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后会讨论这意味着什么，但让我们先回溯一下。

sentences.en: I grew up a typical kid.
sentences.zh: 我从小就是个普通的孩子。

sentences.en: I was an extremely aggressive athlete, so that was kind of my thing.
sentences.zh: 我曾是一名极具侵略性的运动员，那是我的强项。

sentences.en: I was a baseball, football, basketball player.
I had musical interest from very early on.
sentences.zh: 我很早就对音乐产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: My grandmother was an organ player for the church.
sentences.zh: 我祖母是教堂的管风琴手。

sentences.en: So, I mean, I was around it.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我从小就接触这些。

sentences.en: I remember Sunday mornings going, sitting next to her on the bench.
sentences.zh: 我记得周日早上会坐在她旁边的长凳上。

sentences.en: And even though I didn't understand, you know, what she was doing
sentences.zh: 尽管我不明白她在做什么，

sentences.en: or how to play the instrument, I loved to sit with her and sing.
sentences.zh: 也不懂怎么演奏乐器，但我喜欢坐在她身边唱歌。

sentences.en: And it was just my comfort zone as a child.
When I go to church, I get to sit and watch her play the organ and sing.
sentences.zh: 我去教堂时，可以坐着看她弹管风琴，跟着唱歌。

sentences.en: At his mother's insistence, Derek dabbled in music.
sentences.zh: 在母亲的坚持下，德里克曾浅尝辄止地接触过音乐。

sentences.en: He joined the school band, played drums, tinkered around with a guitar,

sentences.zh: 还和朋友组建过摇滚乐队。

sentences.en: But he did not take formal lessons or get any musical training.
sentences.zh: 但他从未接受过正规课程或任何音乐训练。

sentences.en: What happens to Derek in 2006 is both terrifying and fascinating.
sentences.zh: 2006年发生在德里克身上的事既可怕又迷人。

sentences.en: He was in South Dakota visiting friends and family.

sentences.zh: 我们打算在泳池边搞个烧烤派对，那是个室内泳池。

sentences.en: And we were horsing around, and this young man walked in.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在打闹，这时一个年轻人走了进来。

sentences.en: And he must have been about 14, 12, 14.
And he had this little miniature football with him.
So, of course, we started throwing the football at each other.
